cards.card_text: God sent him ahead, Joseph says, to preserve them as a remnant on the earth and to save their lives by a great deliverance.
cards.verse_text: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
cards.snippet: …remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

cards.card_text: The Israelites cry out for deliverance from their bondage.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
cards.snippet: …and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.

cards.card_text: He says, 'You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.'
cards.verse_text: And being very thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.
cards.snippet: …thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.

cards.card_text: Samson has just told the LORD that He accomplished this great deliverance.
cards.verse_text: And being very thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.
cards.snippet: …thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.

cards.card_text: He brought a great deliverance for Israel He promised never to do it again He offered a sacrifice for his sin
cards.verse_text: But the people said to Saul, “Must Jonathan die—he who accomplished such a great deliverance for Israel?
cards.snippet: …people said to Saul, “Must Jonathan die—he who accomplished such a great deliverance for Israel?

cards.card_text: The LORD will soon grant them deliverance, and His wrath won't be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.
cards.verse_text: When the LORD saw that they had humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance.
cards.snippet: …humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but will soon grant them deliverance.

cards.verse_text: You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance.
cards.snippet: You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance.

cards.card_text: David calls God the God of our salvation and a God of deliverance.
cards.verse_text: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
cards.snippet: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.

cards.card_text: Solomon says, "Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing…" So what does he say brings deliverance from death?
cards.verse_text: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
cards.snippet: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.

cards.card_text: Solomon says ___ is what brings deliverance from death.
cards.verse_text: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
cards.snippet: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.

cards.card_text: If a nation falls for lack of guidance, what does Solomon say brings deliverance?
cards.verse_text: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
cards.snippet: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.

cards.card_text: They'll look at what has happened to their source of hope, the ones they fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria.
cards.verse_text: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria!
cards.snippet: …our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria!

cards.card_text: Then a place is named: on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance.
cards.verse_text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
cards.snippet: …be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.

cards.card_text: The LORD says the deliverance on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem will be among the ___ called by the LORD.
cards.verse_text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
cards.snippet: …be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD turns to Mount Zion in Jerusalem: "But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy…"
cards.verse_text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim their possession.
cards.snippet: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, and it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will reclaim…

cards.card_text: And Zechariah says that oath is to grant them deliverance from hostile hands.
cards.verse_text: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
cards.snippet: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,

cards.verse_text: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
cards.snippet: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
